Perfect! Black wins the rook (material advantage +5). This is clearly the best move.

**Best move:** Nb5+

**Main line:** Nb5+ Kd5 Nxc7+ Kd4 (or any king move) and Black is up a whole rook.

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching note:**

When your opponent's king moves to an advanced square, check for knight forks. Nb5+ checks the king while attacking the rook—the classic "royal fork." After any king move, you simply capture the undefended rook with check. Always scan for forcing moves (checks and captures) that hit multiple pieces at once; they often win material instantly.
